scares.description: A sudden knock on the front door breaks the silence as Pam turns around to find a stranger outside wearing the killer's mask.
A sudden musical sting is heard as the masked stranger re-emerges.
A misdirection involving a knock at a door other than the one in focus.
Jamie screams as the shot of a zombified witch dummy suddenly appears.
Anti-climactic reveal leads to a dramatic musical sting, leading to a short-lived confrontation with Lurch.
Jamie jumps in surprise when Kara approaches in a reaper costume, accompanied by a musical sting.
A musical sting plays as Marisa is scared by a puppet in the haunted house.
A musical sting identical to the previous plays, this time as the masked killer interacts with the haunted house.
A second killer emerges from the shadows, immediately killing Marisa. There is a prolonged moment of shock and hysteria.
A small musical sting as the masked killer appears and dashes towards Kara.
A tense moment abruptly stopped by a shot of Chris Dubusage's face, accompanied by a musical sting.
